visualCharacteristics: Full-bleed dark media hero: a poster image with a circular play button overlaid (top-right). Clicking play opens the video in a modal dialog. Optional heading/subtext + CTA can sit over the poster lower-left.
contentPattern: Standalone: a poster image cell, an optional link cell whose href is the video URL (YouTube/Vimeo/mp4), and optional text (heading, subtext, CTA). Falls back to just the poster when no video URL is present.
